description: Surya Roshni Limited manufactures and sells steel pipes and strips, and lighting and consumer durables in India. The company offers GI pipes for agriculture and irrigation, casing and tubing, water transportation/plumbing and pipelines, green houses, firefighting, street light poles, and solar panels; API/3LPE coated spiral pipes for oil and gas, and water transportation, and city gas distribution; CR strips; hollow section pipes; spiral welded pipes; cold rolled strips and sheets; and black pipes for construction, fabrication, fencing, railway platforms and metros, airports, powder coating, sign boards, industrial application, and scaffoldings. It also provides various indoor commercial, retail lighting, industrial lighting, street lighting, flood lighting, facade lighting, landscape lighting, solar lighting, high mast lighting, and sensors; and consumer lighting products, including panels and LED downlighters, decorative lights, LED battens, LED lamps, street and flood lights, torches, extension boards, GLS, FTL fittings and ballast, and wires and cables. In addition, the company offers ceiling, designer, BLDC, pedestal, table, and exhaust fans; home appliances, including water heaters, room heaters, air coolers, steam irons, juicer-mixer-grinders, and induction cooktops; and domestic wires. Further, it provides PVC Pressure pipes and fittings for water supply and pressure applications; CPVC pipes and fittings for hot and cold-water transportation; UPVC plumbing pipes and fittings for residential and commercial plumbing; UPVC SWR pipes and fittings for soil, waste and rainwater drainage systems, and water storage tanks for safe and reliable water storage solutions. The company also exports its products to the United States, Australia, Canada, Mexico, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, and internationally. Surya Roshni Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
